text:
ravi: Quick sync: planning a staggered canary for v5-sparse-int4 tomorrow 09:30 UTC. This is the sparsity-enabled build; expect lower cost but possible rerank variance. Need gate rules.
emma: What slices should we monitor? rerank_nDCG, retrieval_precision, short-answer_factual, latency_tail?
ravi: Exactly. Also monitor token-efficiency delta and model-size memory OOMs. From bench: nDCG +0.6% on rerank test, retrieval_precision flat, latency_p99 +18ms. But short-answer factual failed 0.7% on a curated QA set.
noah: Proposal: staggered gate levels: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10%. At each step require: (1) rerank_nDCG delta >= 0.3% and p<0.05 over rolling 60m, (2) short-answer_factual delta < 0.4% abs, (3) latency_p99 <= baseline*1.20. If any fail, trigger partial fallback.
tia: Small tweak: for rerank prefer bootstrap CI instead of simple p-value because traffic is heavy-tailed. Also require entropy_check: if mean entropy drops >5% may indicate calibration shifts.
ravi: Good call. Add entropy_drop threshold 5% with z-window 10m. For fallback behavior: prefer targeted slice-level routing first (route failing slices to v5-int8-sibling), then full rollback to v4-stable.
ops-bot: Canary deployment queued: v5-sparse-int4 at 0.5% traffic at 2026-04-01T09:30:00Z (canary id: canary-4991230000).
noah: We should mute gating for the first 20m to let KV-cache and sparse-kernel JIT warmup stabilize. Also require min_effective_samples=1500 per slice before gating acts.
tia: Also add synthetic adversarial QA probes every 10m and a treasure set of 200 items for long-doc retrieval tests. Run those against both candidate and baseline.
emma: For alerting: create composite signal "rerank_regress_or_factual" = (bootstrap CI lower bound < 0 AND factual_delta > 0.4%) OR (entropy_drop > 5%). On composite -> mark unhealthy.
ravi: Logging: capture sample payloads for any flagged requests (anonymized). Keep a rolling buffer for 30m to help triage.
ops-bot: Canary started: v5-sparse-int4 @0.5% traffic at 2026-04-01T09:30:05Z.
ops-bot: Alert: composite signal triggered at 2026-04-01T09:58:42Z - factual_delta 0.72% (z=3.1). Initiating targeted fallback: 0.4% traffic routed to v5-int8-sibling at 2026-04-01T09:59:02Z.
ravi: Dropping global traffic to 0.2% and kicking off quick regen with adjusted sparsity schedule. Will re-run the long-doc treasure set after 30m.
noah: We should capture model activations for a small random sample to inspect attention sparsity patterns offline. Requesting ops for activation dump hook.
tia: I'll add post-fallback smoke checklist and schedule a follow-up async doc.
emma: Action items: noah -> bootstrap CI dashboard; tia -> synthetic probes; ravi -> coordinate rollback and samples; ops -> activation dumps + anonymized logs.
ravi: Thanks all. Will post results and a short postmortem if tuning doesn't resolve.
